title.narrative: Core Contribution to the Global Community Engagement and Resilience Fund (GCERF) for 2023-2026

description.narrative: By 2026, GCERF has successfully contributed to prevent and counter violent extremism by successfully addressing national and regional priorities.

The core objective of this engagement is to strengthen local communities’ resilience to violent extremism through an unearmarked core contribution that will enable GCERF to focus on four resilience factors that particularly influence radicalisation and recruitment to violent extremism:
1. To help vulnerable communities in fragile and poor countries build and strengthen social cohesion during conflict and societal change (social cohesion). 2. To improve the capacity of communities to engage with government authorities to represent their own interests (community agency). 3. To remove barriers to social and economic opportunities for youth and women, thus countering violent extremist offers (equal access to opportunities). 4. To develop critical thinking and confidence among youth and communities to resist violent extremism (sense of purpose).
